'''Rhaler's Bastion''' was a mountainous region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was bordered by the [[Denendre Valley]] and the [[Bindreg Hills]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
The [[Hidden Rebel Base]] was located in the depth of the mountain range during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhaler's Bastion is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
